main_measure.name: abs(forecast)-weighted mean excess next-bar return on forecast<0 bars
main_measure.threshold: negative with t <= -2 confirms (with slope < 0); positive with t >= +2 rejects; 100 cases over 60 days minimum

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess next-bar return on abs(forecast) below 0

reading: Falling profile read from the recorded regime 'unknown' (the detector's 60-bar trend is not recorded); the situation is raw scaled_rise > 0 in that regime, expected side short; the day-clustered t uses per-day sums of w*(excess - weighted mean) over sum(w) with a D/(D-1) correction; days are UTC dates of the case bar.
decided_by: Inconclusive: the t lies between -2 and +2.
